Trials by therapeutic agent

Post-viral trials by agent

64 interventions tested in two or more trials · updated October 2026

Research Tracker › Clinical trials › By agent

Last updated 10 October 2026 from ClinicalTrials.gov. Trial statuses are refreshed automatically; check the registry record for the latest status and contact details.

Each page lists every Long COVID, ME/CFS and post-viral-overlap trial in our ClinicalTrials.gov extract that tests the named intervention, with status badges so you can see at a glance whether a treatment is still being studied, has completed, or was stopped. Interventions that appear in only one trial (665 of 729 distinct intervention strings) are searchable in the interactive trial finder. Placebo, saline and usual-care comparator arms are excluded here.
